mapper.select: select exists ( select 1 from rbac_role_binding b join rbac_role r on r.id = b.role_id and r.status = 'ENABLED' and r.deleted_at is null join rbac_role_permission rp on rp.role_id = r.id and rp.effect = 'ALLOW' and rp.deleted_at is null join rbac_permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id and p.status = 'ENABLED' and p.code = #{permission} where b.subject_type = 'USER' and b.subject_id = #{userId} and b.status = 'ENABLED' and b.deleted_at is null and (b.expires_at is null or b.expires_at > now()) and ( b.scope_type = 'PLATFORM' or ( #{scopeType} = 'PROJECT' and b.scope_type = 'PROJECT' and b.scope_id = #{scopeId} ) ) limit 1 )
